prompt: A chaotic kitchen scene. A chef wearing a tall white hat and a food-stained apron is standing behind a messy countertop. The chef's hat is taller than the pot of boiling water. A ginger cat is sitting on top of the counter, to the chef's right. The chef is holding a large knife and is in the middle of chopping vegetables on a cutting board. Next to the cutting board, four red tomatoes are arranged in a line. The cat is batting at a rolling pin that is lying on the counter; the rolling pin is thicker than the knife's handle. The countertop is between the chef and a pot of boiling water on a stove. A bag of flour has been knocked over, and flour is covering a section of the counter to the left of the cat. A spoon holder on the counter, positioned behind the tomatoes, contains a few spoons; their number is two less than the number of tomatoes. The cat is facing the rolling pin. Under the counter, a single mouse is peeking out from behind a cabinet door. The pot of water is releasing a large amount of steam. The stove has several control knobs on its front panel, and the number of knobs is one more than the number of tomatoes. The cat is knocking a spoon with its paw. The rolling pin is between the cat and the pot of water.
